name: Implement VQE in Cirq (with sympy parameters and scipy) for the 2-qubit Hamilton
task_prompt: Implement VQE in Cirq (with sympy parameters and scipy) for the 2-qubit Hamiltonian H = 1.19*Z0*Z1 + 0.93*X0 + 0.93*X1. Compare the optimized energy with exact diagonalization. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
